claim: Targeted expert review of high-uncertainty or high-impact learner claims produces more learning value per expert-minute than direct expert tutoring.
rationale: LLMs can handle information retrieval and routine explanation while scarce experts contribute judgment where value of information is highest.
falsification: Targeted review does not improve later learner capability or requires equal/greater expert effort than direct tutoring for comparable outcomes.
target_capability: Correct and well-calibrated domain mental models.
scope: Requires expert participation and an expert-effort measurement protocol.
